final_answer:
Based on Microsoft's FY2024 10-K income statement data:

Gross margin (dollar amount) = Revenue − Cost of revenue = $245,122 million − $74,114 million = $171,008 million [DOC-1]

Gross margin (percentage) = $171,008 million / $245,122 million ≈ 69.8% [DOC-1]

Both figures relate to the same fiscal year (FY2024, ended June 30, 2024) and are drawn directly from the comparable income statement line items, so no adjustment for non-comparable periods or accounting bases is needed.

ANSWER: Gross margin was approximately $171,008 million, or about 69.8% of revenue, for fiscal year 2024.
